# Realtiy

> Realtiy is the real-estate content desk of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It produces UGC walkthroughs and creator tours for compounds and units, off-plan launch campaign content, developer brand content and broker/agent personal-brand content in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf — and publishes free, practical guides for developers and brokers on filming unit tours that sell, building trust for off-plan launches, and briefing creators for property tours.

## Guides for developers & brokers (free content)
- Content marketing for Saudi real-estate projects (https://realtiy.com/en.html#guide-saudi): the Saudi buyer starts on platforms — real creator tours before renders, payment talk only from the developer's official materials with no return promises, and a content rhythm across the project's life from off-plan launch to handover, tuned per city (Riyadh, Jeddah, Eastern Province). Arabic: https://realtiy.com/#guide-saudi
- Real-estate UGC in Egypt: the unit video that sells from the first watch (https://realtiy.com/en.html#guide-egypt): answer the Egyptian buyer's first two questions in the first seconds — what the place really looks like, and how payment works (official plan only, no return promises, no prices in public content) — with a natural Egyptian voice and the buyer's real questions. Arabic: https://realtiy.com/#guide-egypt
- Real building content on the homepages (https://realtiy.com/#works): three videos from the Kayan Lifts content series and a residential lift-awareness series produced by influUGC — playable with posters. English: https://realtiy.com/en.html#works

- How a unit walkthrough should be shot to sell the unit: start at the front door and walk in the order of a buyer's day (entrance, living, kitchen, bedrooms, bathrooms, balcony), honest scale with real furniture, the practical details buyers ask about (storage, kitchen workflow, bathrooms, balcony use), natural light and a real voice — the unit first, the compound's context last. Beauty shots earn admiration; an honest tour books visits.
- UGC for off-plan launches — building trust before delivery: film the developer's delivered record first, dated and repeated construction-progress series from the same angles, the show unit filmed honestly (what is included in delivery vs display), fear-question videos answering one buyer worry each, and only the published payment plan — never return promises or price predictions. Renders are always labelled as renders.
- What to put in a creator brief for a real-estate tour: location facts exactly as published, unit facts (area, layout, delivered finishing, what a furnished show unit includes), payment-plan facts split into may-say (official plan, announced delivery date, official offers) and may-not-say (return promises, appreciation predictions, invented dates, unapproved prices), paid-partnership disclosure, labelled renders, access/drone permits arranged by production, and deliverables + usage scope agreed in writing before filming.

## Services (content & UGC for real estate)

- UGC Walkthroughs & Creator Tours for Compounds and Units: creator-filmed tours inside real units, in a buyer's walking order, made to turn views into booked visits.
- Launch Campaign Content (Off-Plan): trust-building launch content — delivered-record tours, construction-progress series, fear-question videos, with hard lines around financial claims.
- Developer Brand Content: project stories, corporate films and a steady social presence for the developer's own brand.
- Broker & Agent Personal-Brand Content: recurring unit tours and area explainers in the agent's name.
- Launch-Event Coverage: creator invitations, same-day event content and a post-launch asset pack.
